Here is a sample Semgrep rule in YAML format for the vulnerability-fixing evidence provided:

```yaml
---
id: "vuln-portofino-94653cb3"
type: "file"
languages: 
  - "java"
severity: "ERROR" # or WARNING, INFO
message: "Insecure temporary file creation in Apache Tomcat"
description: "Apache Tomcat creates a temporary directory using File.createTempFile(). This method does not have any security checks and can be exploited to create files with arbitrary names."
references: 
  - "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-3952"
  - "https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/377.html"
  - "https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/668.html"
metadata:
  affected_functions:
    - "WarFileLauncher.createTempDir(int)"
  description: "Apache Tomcat creates a temporary directory using File.createTempFile(). This method does not have any security checks and can be exploited to create files with arbitrary names."
pattern: 
  - "function-call-arg": {
      "arguments": ["java.io.File.createTempFile(String, String)"],
      "return": {"type": "java.io.File"}
    }
```

This rule will match any function call that creates a temporary file using `File.createTempFile()`. The pattern field is used to specify the behavior of the vulnerable code and the metadata field provides additional information about the vulnerability.
